items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: We worked for him quite often. Maybe, maybe, uh, once a month for maybe six months, I'd say.

ctx.x: What kind of business man was Sam Montel? Who wanted to take care of this man?

I don't know. Because I didn't have a chance to be around him too very much. Except for the time that I worked for him. Well, maybe once or twice. At the nightclub and all that, at this community center in Baton Rouge. We worked for him quite often. Maybe, maybe, uh, once a month for maybe six months, I'd say. And, uh, well, he had to treat us, honestly, then because, well, the crowd spoke for itself. You know, like, we go in places, we see, we see a gymnasium full of people. He had to pay us, you know, and, and…
Is that the same thing about Johnny Vinson?
